description: Get a stored Bot Appétit report by scan id, the same report a person sees at botappetit.ai/r/<id>. Costs nothing and does not scan. Use it to re-read a report you were given a link to. A page that blocked our scanner is returned as blocked, with no score.

id.description: The scan id: the last part of a report link on botappetit.ai/r/<id>, or `scan_id` from scan_page.

name: get_report
title: Get a stored report
